Release v0.4.10

Release v0.4.10

- Connect: the Bluetooth scan now shows only TVS scooters, so your ride is easier to spot
- Navigation: save home, work, and your own spots, then jump to them in one tap
- Navigation: fixed the distance and arrival time estimates
- Navigation: the Google Maps mirror switches to the right screen on its own, and dismissing a Maps notification now clears it in Scoot too
- Diagnostic shell: the mirror check shows whether the maneuver arrow arrived, and can copy the raw notification as JSON
